steps.label: Reach the tray
steps.desc: Left hand to 10 cm in front of the handle bar; right hand 15 cm under where it will support the tray.

steps.label: Grasp the handle
steps.desc: Straight onto the bar; the fingertips pinch it.

steps.label: Pull the tray 55 cm
steps.desc: One hand, while the back end still rests on the board.

steps.label: Support it from below
steps.desc: Right hand up under the tray, fingers either side, 15 cm from the back end, before the tray leaves the board.

steps.label: Take it out together (15 cm)
steps.desc: Both hands carry the tray until its back end is clear of the shelf.

steps.label: Lift the tray
steps.desc: Both hands lift the tray 5 cm, level.
